WITH sp AS (
    SELECT s."Store_ID", s."Store_Name", p."Product_ID", p."product" AS "Product_Name",
           COUNT(*) AS total_quantity,
           AVG(p."dpi") AS average_selling_price
    FROM "store" s
    JOIN "store_product" sp ON s."Store_ID" = sp."Store_ID"
    JOIN "product" p ON sp."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
    GROUP BY s."Store_ID", s."Store_Name", p."Product_ID", p."product"
),
store_stats AS (
    SELECT "Store_ID", "Store_Name",
           AVG(average_selling_price) AS store_avg_price
    FROM sp
    GROUP BY "Store_ID", "Store_Name"
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT ss.*,
           RANK() OVER (ORDER BY store_avg_price DESC) AS store_ranking
    FROM store_stats ss
)
SELECT sp."Store_Name",
       sp."Product_Name",
       sp."total_quantity",
       sp."average_selling_price",
       r."store_ranking"
FROM sp
JOIN ranked r ON sp."Store_ID" = r."Store_ID"
ORDER BY sp."Store_Name", sp."Product_Name";

SELECT

votes.sql: SELECT s.Store_Name, COUNT(sp.Product_ID) AS scanner_count FROM "store" s JOIN "store_product" sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID JOIN "product" p ON sp.Product_ID = p.product_id WHERE LOWER(p.product) LIKE '%scanner%' GROUP BY s.Store_ID ORDER BY s.Store_Name

WITH monthly AS (
    SELECT s."Store_Name",
           strftime('%Y-%m', sp."Sale_Date") AS "Month",
           COUNT(*) AS "Scanner_Count"
    FROM "store" s
    JOIN "store_product" sp ON s."Store_ID" = sp."Store_ID"
    JOIN "product" p ON sp."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
    GROUP BY s."Store_Name", strftime('%Y-%m', sp."Sale_Date")
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT *,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY "Store_Name" ORDER BY "Scanner_Count" DESC) AS rnk
    FROM monthly
)
SELECT "Store_Name",
       "Month",
       "Scanner_Count",
       CASE WHEN rnk = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "Is_Top_Month"
FROM ranked
ORDER BY "Store_Name", "Month";

votes.sql:
WITH store_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        s.Type,
        s.Store_ID,
        s.Store_Name,
        s.Ranking,
        s.Area_size,
        AVG(d.City_Population) OVER (PARTITION BY s.District_ID) AS district_avg_population
    FROM store s
    JOIN store_district sd ON s.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
    JOIN district d ON sd.District_ID = d.District_ID
)
SELECT 
    Type,
    Store_Name,
    Ranking,
    Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY Type ORDER BY Ranking ASC) AS type_rank
FROM store_metrics
WHERE Row_Number() OVER (PARTITION BY Type ORDER BY Ranking ASC) <= 3
ORDER BY Type, Ranking ASC
LIMIT 3;

votes.sql:
-- Cumulative sales trend per store type (proxy: total number of product associations)
SELECT s.Type AS store_type,
       COUNT(sp.Product_ID) AS cumulative_sales_trend
FROM store s
LEFT JOIN store_product sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
GROUP BY s.Type
ORDER BY s.Type;

-- Top 3 stores that peaked in revenue compared to district's average
WITH store_product_count AS (
    SELECT s.Store_ID,
           s.Store_Name,
           s.Type,
           COUNT(sp.Product_ID) AS product_count
    FROM store s
    LEFT JOIN store_product sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
    GROUP BY s.Store_ID, s.Store_Name, s.Type
),
district_avg AS (
    SELECT sd.District_ID,
           AVG(spc.product_count) AS avg_product_count
    FROM store_district sd
    JOIN store_product_count spc ON sd.Store_ID = spc.Store_ID
    GROUP BY sd.District_ID
)
SELECT spc.Store_Name,
       (spc.product_count - da.avg_product_count) AS revenue_vs_district_avg
FROM store_product_count spc
JOIN store_district sd ON spc.Store_ID = sd.Store_ID
JOIN district_avg da ON sd.District_ID = da.District_ID
ORDER BY revenue_vs_district_avg DESC
LIMIT 3;

ranked AS (

WHERE rn = 1;

FROM store s

WITH RECURSIVE district_hierarchy AS (
    SELECT d."District_ID", d."District_name"
    FROM "district" d
    JOIN "store_district" sd ON d."District_ID" = sd."District_ID"
    JOIN "store" s ON sd."Store_ID" = s."Store_ID"
    JOIN "store_product" sp ON s."Store_ID" = sp."Store_ID"
    JOIN "product" p ON sp."Product_ID" = p."Product_ID"
    WHERE p."dpi" = 600.0
    UNION ALL
    SELECT NULL, NULL WHERE FALSE
)
SELECT dh."District_name",
       NULL AS aggregated_monthly_sales_performance
FROM district_hierarchy dh
GROUP BY dh."District_name";

SELECT d.District_name, AVG(p.warranty_period_months) AS avg_warranty
FROM district d
JOIN store_district sd ON d.District_ID = sd.District_ID
JOIN store s ON sd.Store_ID = s.Store_ID
JOIN store_product sp ON s.Store_ID = sp.Store_ID
JOIN product p ON sp.Product_ID = p.product_id
GROUP BY d.District_ID
